title: Rollers fleet
description: A ruled two-column grid of large square-cornered photo cards with orange arrow tiles, the right column set lower than the left; on wide screens the columns drift against each other as you scroll (left down, right up, 100px each). Under it a ruled row with one orange button that slides in from the right.
notes: made for four cards (two per column); any even number works
the drift is a CSS view timeline on each column; phones stack the cards without it
media is a placeholder until you pass an with object-cover and full size
name: rollers-fleet
